blocks.text: ACCORDING TO THE NEW YORK TIMES, US INTELLIGENCE SUSPECTS A CHINESE BUSINESSWOMAN, CLOSE TO THE HEAD OF NVIDIA, OF SPYING FOR BEIJING.
NVIDIA DENIES ANY WRONGDOING. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE ITS CEO KNEW ANYTHING.
THREE DAYS OF INTERVIEWS, AND IT'S THE NEW YORK TIMES THAT BREAKS THE STORY.
A SPY, A CEO, A PRESIDENT WHO DOESN'T LIFT A FINGER... ALL IT NEEDS IS SOMEONE TO TELL IT.
